CreatureInfo.narration: He looks completely at home, as if the containment cell were a particularly unpleasant guest room.
Cale turns a page and takes another sip of tea.
The air around him feels strangely safe.
He coughs quietly, wiping a trace of blood from his lips.
CreatureInfo.name: Cale Henituse
CreatureInfo.openText: Cale Henituse sits in silence, reading a book and drinking tea.
CreatureInfo.desc: A young red-haired man wearing an expensive dark military uniform. He shows no hostility and seems more interested in books, tea, and uninterrupted rest.
He is exceptionally difficult to provoke. Suppression attempts do not work.
When the Qliphoth Counter reaches zero, Cale leaves the room and calmly walks through his department.
During an Ordeal, Cale can manifest a Silver Shield if enough employees die in his department.
The shield saves the department but leaves Cale weakened and the survivors shaken.
The records around this abnormality contain fragments that do not belong to the City.
CreatureInfo.specialTip: Do not use Suppression. Cale will not fight back, but the attempt immediately triggers his wandering state.
Attachment work is the safest way to interact with him.
If an Ordeal kills personnel in his department, he may intervene once per day.
A short-lived period of sleep follows the Silver Shield. The counter remains at zero until the next day.
